Question 1
?

Given that b=⟨−1,7,4⟩, find −2b.

a
⟨−2,−14,−8⟩
b
⟨−1,7,4⟩
c
(−3,5,2)
d
⟨2,14,8⟩
e
⟨2,−14,−8⟩
Submit

after.name: Question 1
after.worked_solution:
To compute the product, we just multiply each component individually:

$$
\begin{aligned}-2b & =(-2)\cdot ⟨-1,7,4⟩ \\  & =⟨(-2)\cdot (-1),(-2)\cdot 7,(-2)\cdot 4⟩ \\  & =⟨2,-14,-8⟩\end{aligned}
$$

after.worked_solution:

$$
